text:
sasha (Support): customer reports repeated 502/504 + request timeouts from EU-west starting ~23:00 UTC. multiple customer endpoints affected, p95 latency jumped, customer says SDK v1.4.2.
maya (SRE): got the ticket. can you paste a sample request id or curl? any correlation ids?
sasha (Support): example request IDs: req_eu_98a3, req_eu_98a4. customer repro steps below, they hit our /v1/generate endpoint concurrently from a server pool (50 concurrent threads) with short per-request timeouts and no connection pooling. thinks it started after they rolled SDK v1.4.2.
sasha (Support): ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -H "Connection: close" -d '{"input":"<very long prompt>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
ken (Runtime Eng): interesting, they set `Connection: close` and spawn many short-lived connections. traces show spike in upstream SYNs and many TIME_WAIT sockets on edge. NGINX upstreams started queuing, we hit the gateway worker connection limit -> 502s.
ken (Runtime Eng): runtime logs show memory pressure on a few inference pods too (KV cache churn) but primary signal is proxy conn churn causing request queuing, not model OOMs.
maya (SRE): i've pulled edge metrics and confirmed a ~4x increase in new TCP connections/sec from that tenant pool at 23:02 UTC, matching the SDK rollout time. conn pool metric for apigw hit 95% of available file descriptors.
priya (Product): customer says the SDK default changed some retry/timeout behavior in 1.4.2. are we confident recommending they roll back? what's a safe short-term mitigation we can push without client changes?
ken (Runtime Eng): short-term we can: 1) enable upstream keepalive and bump `keepalive_requests` so fewer new conns, 2) apply per-tenant connection rate limit at the gateway (throttle to 20 conn/s), 3) add a circuit-breaker to return 429 for excessive concurrent connection bursts to avoid 502 cascade.
maya (SRE): i can patch apigw config to increase `worker_connections` and enable `keepalive_timeout` tweaks in the next deploy window — but that's not immediate. i'll also create a temporary iptables connlimit rule for the customer's CIDR to protect pool.
sasha (Support): i'll ask the customer to pause the SDK rollout and temporarily enable connection pooling (recommended code snippet). suggest they set `keepAlive: true` and re-use a single HTTP client.
sasha (Support): suggested customer snippet: ```js const client = new RedwoodClient({ keepAlive: true }); // reuse across requests ```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: apigw-config-bump v2 -> staging at 1758625000, prod at 1758626600
ken (Runtime Eng): rolling the circuit-breaker feature flag to prod now for that tenant only. will monitor.
maya (SRE): implemented temporary connlimit for CIDR x.x.x.x/27 at 1758624205 (rate 25 conn/s). observing drop in new connections, apigw fd usage down to 60%. latency p95 improving.
sasha (Support): customer confirmed degradations dropping and fewer 502s. they're rolling back SDK to v1.4.1 on a canary host to validate. :thumbsup:
priya (Product): customer comm: we'll send a short note explaining root cause (SDK connection behavior) + recommended fix + timeline for our permanent changes. assign owner?
ken (Runtime Eng): i'll own the permanent fix. action items: 1) (ken) permanent gateway rate-limiter & tenant-level conn shaping (due 3 days), 2) (maya) apigw tuning playbook + runbook updates (due 48h), 3) (sasha) customer comm + verify rollback test results (due 24h), 4) (ken) add telemetry to surface per-tenant new-conn/sec and TIME_WAIT ratio (due 72h).
sasha (Support): logged the updates in the customer ticket and asked for rollback test report.
priya (Product): we'll schedule a short follow-up postmortem next week with CS + SRE + Runtime to formalize next steps.
ken (Runtime Eng): preliminary RCA: client SDK change -> aggressive new connection creation + `Connection: close` -> apigw fd exhaustion -> increased queueing -> 502/504 and timeouts. secondary effect: KV cache churn on some inference pods because of sudden fanout.
maya (SRE): current status: mitigations holding, no other tenants impacted. i'll keep the connlimit in place until we have a config rollout.
sasha (Support): thanks team — closing the war room for now, will re-open if customer repros after rollback.
priya (Product): noted, will draft the customer comm and postmortem invite. :calendar:
